current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s mostly around food and my body, I guess. I’ve been… well, restrictive eating for years, since I was 18, and I still count calories all the time. I did get some weight back over the last year, but my head is still kind of stuck on it, like I’m constantly thinking about my body shape and it makes eating with other people hard, so I avoid that.
current_concerns.goals: I want to be able to eat a meal with friends without, um, planning it for days beforehand. That would be the big thing.

past_psychiatric_history.previous_diagnoses: Yes, I was told I had anorexia nervosa, restricting type.
past_psychiatric_history.hospital_details: It was 2021, at Toronto General Hospital, and I was there for two weeks.
